sections_en.text: Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Clean the cell with an air blower.
Disconnect terminals (5, 8) from the relay at the back.
Connect the Severker 650 injection test set leads to points (5, 8) on the relay at the back.

Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection test set to terminals (10, 11) on the relay at the back (note: connect point 11 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, and connect point 10 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, without disconnecting terminals (10, 11) on the relay at the back).
Set the injection voltage value to (100 V).
Remove the plastic cover from the relay at the front.
Refit the plastic cover on the relay at the front.
Reset the lock-out relay on the cell, confirming this by hearing the sound of the relay and by the CB Trip indication lamp going out.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the red indication on the relay appears.
Raise the injection voltage value to 100 volts.
Remove the plastic cover from the relay at the front.
Refit the plastic cover on the relay at the front.
Reset the lock-out relay on the cell, confirming this by hearing the sound of the relay and by the CB Trip indication lamp going out.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the Severker 650 injection test set operating switch to the (Off Time) position.
Record the relay operating time value (note that the Severker 650 injection test set switches off automatically after the relay operates).
Reduce the voltage to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Reconnect terminals (5, 8) on the relay at the back.
Remove the plastic cover from the relay at the front.
Refit the plastic cover on the relay at the front.
Reset the lock-out relay on the cell, confirming this by hearing the sound of the relay and by the CB Trip indication lamp going out.
